releases.title: Verity
releases.synopsis: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

releases.title: Beware Boiúna
releases.synopsis: A medical mission deep in the Amazon becomes a desperate fight for survival when a colossal ancient predator awakens, turning the jungle into a deadly battleground where nature decides who lives and dies.

releases.title: Buddy
releases.synopsis: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

releases.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
releases.synopsis: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

releases.title: Ghost in the Cell
releases.synopsis: In a notorious prison, an invisible force begins killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.

releases.title: Digger
releases.synopsis: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

releases.title: Love of Your Life
releases.synopsis: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

releases.title: April X
releases.synopsis: When his twin sister April (Lilly Krug) goes missing, Bax (Connor Storrie) searches every corner of their futuristic, post-Soviet cityscape to find her. Ultimately descending into a violent criminal underworld and madness, Bax is forced to confront the cost of identity, love, and survival.

releases.title: Avaraachan & Sons
releases.synopsis: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

releases.title: Rolling Loud: The Movie
releases.synopsis: Desperate to reconnect with his distant son, a father secretly takes him to the chaos of Rolling Loud, only to plunge into a wild, frantic search across the massive hip-hop festival when the 13-year-old vanishes into the crowd.

releases.title: The Opera!
releases.synopsis: The Three Chaps; Prescott, Chogurt, and Dr. Wilbert, await to see Lady Hogsmash LIVE at The Opera. While appreciating some lobby art, a horrific travesty unfolds, leaving The Chaps to wonder if they'll make it out of The Opera House on a high note.

releases.title: Repo
releases.synopsis: After his last job went wrong, local fixer John is trying to get out of the game. His criminal boss, Indiana Slim, refuses to give John his final payment unless he does one final job, leaving John with two options: complete one last job, or leave empty handed

releases.title: Premada Oorali
releases.synopsis: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

releases.title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
releases.synopsis: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

releases.title: Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil
releases.synopsis: Nobita and friends finds a secret underwater castle packed with mysteries and riches. With Doraemon's high-tech gadgets, they dive into an ocean adventure mixing humor, teamwork, and imagination in a breathtaking aquatic world.

releases.title: Hanuman Ansh
releases.synopsis: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

releases.title: Don't Trouble the Trouble
releases.synopsis: Suri, a magician, accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

releases.title: Thella Kaagitham
releases.synopsis: Two teenagers discover first love amid the innocence, mischief, and uncertainties of adolescence. As they fall deeper for each other, the choices they make begin to carry consequences neither is prepared for.

releases.title: Sigma
releases.synopsis: A daring treasure hunter throws caution to the wind, outwitting deadly traps and treacherous allies with sheer nerve and cunning.

releases.title: Anbil Avan
releases.synopsis: A married couple attempts to start a good life together, but unexpected trouble traps them in an unsettling situation that forces them to fight back for their survival.

releases.title: Anakapalli
releases.synopsis: In rural Anakapalli, a young man enters the criminal underworld under a feared gangster. When love arrives, he faces a choice between power, loyalty, and his former dreams in this tale of action and destiny.

releases.title: The Third Murder
releases.synopsis: When businessman Boban is murdered in the same manner as drug peddler Justin, DYSP Christy brings in ex-cop Swamy, an expert in serial killer cases. Their investigation leads to Aditya, a troubled teenager caught in conflict with his eccentric father, as hidden motives emerge and a deadly hunt begins to stop a third murder.

releases.title: SI Yugandhar
releases.synopsis: An honest cop's discovery of a mysterious body launches a high-stakes investigation, forcing him to uncover a dark web of secrets hidden beneath the city's surface.

releases.title: Prem Keetanu
releases.synopsis: A group of young men and their turbulent college life, where bad grades and hopelessness remain in the driver's seat. Even as they pursue love, friendship and aspirations, the film promises to capture the current generation's struggles and dreams in a light-hearted yet heartfelt manner.

releases.title: Almari
releases.synopsis: When a family discovers the enchanting powers of their old mysterious cupboard, their lives spiral into a web of desires, drawing both - foes and vices to their doorstep.

releases.title: Bail
releases.synopsis: After a long wait for justice in a case that affected him personally, retired commissioner Vijay Kumar becomes an outlaw who serves justice.

releases.title: Bhootu Aaya Bhago
releases.synopsis: Three friends find themselves trapped in a series of mysterious and supernatural incidents inside a hospital.

releases.title: Impure
releases.synopsis: A dramedy about a woman whose wedding gets called off once her in-laws find out she’s not a virgin

releases.title: Izhakalkkappuram
releases.synopsis: In an ancestral home, Dr. Ananth Sivan, an ageing Gandhian scholar, holds firmly to his lifelong beliefs, while his filmmaker daughter Karthi begins to question his convictions. Through their everyday interactions, their relationship unfolds as they navigate the delicate space between ideals, belief, and empathy.

releases.title: Shabara
releases.synopsis: An adventure written in the stars and across time.

releases.title: Other Mommy
releases.synopsis: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

releases.title: Obsession
releases.synopsis: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

releases.title: Animals
releases.synopsis: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

releases.title: Fjord
releases.synopsis: When a devout Romanian family resettles in a small Norwegian town, they become the subject of public scandal when their daughter shows up to school with unexplained bruises. As allegations of abuse emerge, they are swept up in an investigation that blurs the line between concern and prejudice.

releases.title: The Social Reckoning
releases.synopsis: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

releases.title: Tenzing
releases.synopsis: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

releases.title: NAZA
releases.synopsis: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.

releases.title: Red Days 2: Cecilia
releases.synopsis: Following the path of Cecilia, from Red Days, a young woman becomes a vampire during a zombie outbreak. In order to survive and find a new home, she joins a secret organization that turns her into a corporate slayer.

releases.title: Jailer 2
releases.synopsis: When a dangerous syndicate threatens his family, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver to battle enemies from the shadows.

releases.title: Angel and the Badman
releases.synopsis: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.

releases.title: The Florist
releases.synopsis: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

releases.title: V/H/S/MIXTAPE
releases.synopsis: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the volume on horror with a blood-soaked collection of cursed music videos, terrifying performances, and found footage. Press play. Pray it stops.

releases.title: The Beast
releases.synopsis: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

releases.title: Monster Mia
releases.synopsis: 12-year-old Mia and her scruffy pet rat Quentin are sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy after one too many problems at school. The new school gives her the creeps, and Mia needs to figure a way out before the students realize she isn't a monster like them! But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

releases.title: Treasure Trekkers
releases.synopsis: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

releases.title: Musk
releases.synopsis: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world's most heralded "inventor-entrepreneur" who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

releases.title: Misty Green
releases.synopsis: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.

releases.title: Comrade Kalyan
releases.synopsis: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

releases.title: All Pass
releases.synopsis: Three families from different parts of North Chennai come together through circumstances and, despite financial struggles, decide to live under one roof in Sathya Nagar. Their friendship grows into a close-knit bond, with the three families living like one. But when a conflict threatens this unity and puts their relationships at risk, they must face its consequences and decide whether their bond can survive.

releases.title: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku
releases.synopsis: A cop tries to track down Bikram Pramanik, a master of disguise whose wife is a pickpocket.

releases.title: Baa Baa Black Sheep
releases.synopsis: One misplaced object triggers a one-day chain reaction, pulling six strangers into a fun, chaotic journey. As it changes hands, small mistakes lead to comic misunderstandings, awkward encounters, and unexpected connections that change all their lives.

releases.title: The Eken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra
releases.synopsis: A few mysterious men from Kochi arrive out of nowhere and whisk away the ever-baffling Eken Babu to Kerala. As confusion turns into curiosity, Eken finds himself at the centre of a bizarre new mystery.

releases.title: Emperor vs Sarat Chandra
releases.synopsis: Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, loved for his humanist novels, finds himself at the center of a storm when he writes Pather Dabi—a fierytale of Sabyasachi, a revolutionary whose ideas electrify the youth.

releases.title: Only Me
releases.synopsis: A disoriented man wakes up in a car in the middle of nowhere, with a gun, a cryptic note and a bound woman. As events unfold, he is drawn into the disturbing world of a Mumbai model whose carefully constructed rituals blur the lines between victim and predator. Through violence, deception and haunting memories, the film explores trauma, control and the struggle to reclaim one's agency.

releases.title: Kitti
releases.synopsis: A psychological thriller that explores the fragile boundaries between reality, fear, and the human mind. When an unexpected incident disrupts a seemingly ordinary life, the protagonist is drawn into a disturbing chain of events where nothing is what it appears to be. As reality begins to blur, hidden truths slowly emerge, forcing him to confront his deepest fears and question his own perception of what is real.

releases.title: Gondhal
releases.synopsis: Suman, a newly-wedded wife in Maharashtra's Gondhal rituals, conspires with Gondhali Saheba to kill her husband, Anand. They plan to carry out an escape that jeopardises her soul amid drum-driven ritual and divine omens, blurring the distinction between salvation and damnation in a citywide verdict of fire, blood, and awe.

releases.title: Chiram
releases.synopsis: Seetha, a young Malayali research student who travels to Visva-Bharati University in Kolkata to study traditional Baul music and culture.

releases.title: Good Time
releases.synopsis: 'Good Time' follows Jaani, a young cab driver whose life is caught between love, gambling, and bad luck. As everything around him begins to fall apart, he keeps waiting for the one thing he believes will change his life: his Good Time.

releases.title: Ei Shohorer Gaan
releases.synopsis: Set against the vibrant backdrop of Kolkata, this emotional drama weaves together the lives of dreamers searching for love, purpose, and belonging. As their journeys intersect through art, relationships, and personal struggles, they discover the strength to hold on to hope in a city filled with chaos, heartbreak, and possibility.

releases.title: Eh Din Roz Ni Aune
releases.synopsis: In a fortunate encounter, carefree 25-year-old Prabh meets Aavraj, a practical, successful 55-year-old businessman. Their contrasting ideologies create a fun-filled office family drama.

releases.title: Thaainilam
releases.synopsis: A father and his daughter came to India as refugees post-war in their country. Few good hands help them to rebuild their lifestyle.

releases.title: Dhanushkodiyilekku
releases.synopsis: The starkly different lives of two families intertwine across decades of shifting history. While one group barely survived the catastrophic 1964 Dhanushkodi cyclone, the other has only ever known immense wealth.

releases.title: Afreet - A Never Ending Night
releases.synopsis: Three friends gather for what should have been an ordinary evening, but a seemingly harmless challenge unleashes something far older and more dangerous than they could have imagined. As strange events begin to blur the line between reality and the unknown, they find themselves trapped in a night where every choice carries a consequence.  Afreet is a supernatural horror film that explores friendship, fear, and the hidden forces that emerge when curiosity goes too far.

releases.title: La Bola Negra
releases.synopsis: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

releases.title: You Can See Everything
releases.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

releases.title: Street Fighter
releases.synopsis: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

releases.title: Sense and Sensibility
releases.synopsis: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

releases.title: Crawlers
releases.synopsis: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

releases.title: Whalefall
releases.synopsis: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

releases.title: Jailer 2
releases.synopsis: When a dangerous syndicate threatens his family, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver to battle enemies from the shadows.

releases.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
releases.synopsis: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

releases.title: Flywheel: Ignition of the Soul
releases.synopsis: In Rio de Janeiro, Noah Silva is a smooth-talking, used-car salesman whose 'do whatever it takes' approach to business and life begins to unravel at home and at work. After a series of wake-up calls, Noah is forced to confront the cost of his choices. He begins a difficult and deeply personal journey to restore his integrity while trying to win back the hearts of his wife and son.

releases.title: Tazza: The Song of Beelzebub
releases.synopsis: Jang Taeyoung, who believes he has everything after building a successful online casino business, loses it all to his former best friend and namesake, Park Taeyoung. The two reunite on the international poker circuit for a high-stakes battle of revenge.

releases.title: Misty Green
releases.synopsis: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.

releases.title: Ranabaali
releases.synopsis: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

releases.title: You Can't Leave
releases.synopsis: Searching for a missing friend, a group enters a dark forest and discovers an abandoned cabin concealing an ancient evil. As night falls, they must survive the shadows and uncover the truth before it is too late.

releases.title: Nayyi Navelli
releases.synopsis: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

releases.title: Clean Hands
releases.synopsis: Based on a true story, a veteran narcotics officer turned recovery advocate and his daughter, who struggles with addiction, confront the American drug crisis from opposing sides of the law while navigating their complicated family bond.

releases.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
releases.synopsis: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

releases.title: Garividi Lakshmi
releases.synopsis: A gifted folk singer from North Andhra rises to fame through her captivating voice and Burra Katha performances, only to mysteriously disappear at the height of her popularity. Years later, a man sets out to unravel the mystery. What happened to Garividi Lakshmi?

releases.title: Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam
releases.synopsis: Public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam takes on one of the most high-profile criminal cases in India’s history, leading the prosecution in the trial of Ajmal Kasab following the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks. As he battles to uncover the truth and secure justice, Nikam must confront the immense personal and professional burden of a case that will define his legacy.

releases.title: Crazy Kalyanam
releases.synopsis: The story focuses on a village girl, played by Anupama Parameswaran, who faces struggles regarding her inability to get married, which drives the comedic and family-oriented plot.

releases.title: DeSu7
releases.synopsis: After years apart, two people reunite for a fresh start. A story of deep emotion, romance, and action about love that endures and a reunion destined to happen.

releases.title: Drones
releases.synopsis: A sleepwalking student, a mysterious miniature artist, an ancient witch, a doll house of trapped souls, and a cop cursed by love collide in a surreal world.

releases.title: Titans
releases.synopsis: Small-time gangster Antony Yakuza teams up with young programmer Anwar to pull off a major heist, with mysterious driver Rejimon joining them. But Rejimon is not who he seems, and their simple crime soon turns into a strange, unpredictable journey where reality itself begins to blur.

releases.title: Andhkar
releases.synopsis: Andhkar is a suspense thriller about the murder of a famous painter's wife in her bungalow. Set over one night from 6 p.m. to 6 a.m., it is a classic murder mystery where nothing is as it seems.

releases.title: Sohla
releases.synopsis: In a small village where tradition defines destiny, young Pashya eagerly awaits his Sohla, the sacred coming-of-age ceremony. Dreaming of fame and idolizing Salman Khan, he sees it as his moment to shine. But when his father Ramdas's desperate attempt to ease the family's debts ends in tragedy, Pashya's world collapses.  Stripped of innocence, he shoulders the weight of survival with his mother and sister. As grief and duty converge on the day of the ritual, Pashya learns that Sohla is not just a spectacle, but an inheritance of resilience, sacrifice, and true manhood.

releases.title: Poniiy
releases.synopsis: A young local girl's family cares for a dog named Poniiy, whose true owner, a kind-hearted man, has mysteriously gone missing. Determined to reunite them, the girl and Poniiy set out on a heartfelt journey to find him.

releases.title: AWM (Agney Weds Minal)
releases.synopsis: Inspired by real-life stories and the lives of real couples, AWM takes you on an emotional journey of love, relationships, courage, dreams and the choices that shape our lives.

releases.title: Little Hearts: Madness of Love
releases.synopsis: A broke, desperate filmmaker fakes a public proposal to chase online fame. It goes viral, turning into real love, real fallout, and a harsh choice feed the algorithm or protect his heart in a world where emotions are content, at any cost

releases.title: Hope
releases.synopsis: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

releases.title: Drive - The Pretenders
releases.synopsis: A young mechanic fakes an engagement with racing's most scandalous star — officially for his reputation, secretly for her own shot behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything — including what's already become so much more than just a deal.

releases.title: The Mongoose
releases.synopsis: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

releases.title: Wildwood
releases.synopsis: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

releases.title: The Awakening
releases.synopsis: An elite military unit on a mission in the South American jungle encounters a deadly supernatural force revealing an ancient presence that continues to claim anyone who dares enter its domain.

releases.title: Nocturne
releases.synopsis: When a victim of notorious serial killer Jurek Walter unexpectedly turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn races against time to find the one person still missing, while his protégé Saga Bauer goes undercover to get answers from the killer himself.

releases.title: Clayface
releases.synopsis: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

releases.title: Surviving Hurricane Otis
releases.synopsis: Two estranged brothers struggle to survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco, where their bond and courage turn adversity into hope.

releases.title: Possible Love
releases.synopsis: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

releases.title: Wicker
releases.synopsis: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

releases.title: Fatherland
releases.synopsis: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

releases.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
releases.synopsis: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

releases.title: Kung Fu Soccer
releases.synopsis: Dismissed as underdogs before they even step onto the pitch, the Emei Women's Football Team enters the prestigious Supreme Invincible Cup determined to prove everyone wrong. Led by captain Shuangshuang, star striker Yulong, and mentor Xu Feng, the team combines martial arts mastery with football skill in a thrilling quest for victory. Against mounting challenges and impossible odds, they fight to make their mark and chase their championship dream.

releases.title: Gajab Raat
releases.synopsis: A corrupt, troubled cop's night spirals out of control when a reluctant act of mercy toward an injured girl pulls him into a deadly web of crime.

releases.title: You, Me, Us
releases.synopsis: A couple faces the difficult path to adoption, determined to become parents despite their complex vulnerabilities.

releases.title: Klara and the Sun
releases.synopsis: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

releases.title: A Talent for Murder
releases.synopsis: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

releases.title: A Very Arctic Christmas
releases.synopsis: Single dad Jim and his spirited, science-minded 20-year-old daughter, Isla, share a tradition of alternating who decides how they spend Christmas each year. Jim, a former major league baseball player turned broadcaster, never misses hosting his annual Christmas Eve show from Times Square – until Isla persuades him to take a once-in-a-lifetime Arctic cruise, promising they will return in time for his broadcast.

releases.title: YAGA
releases.synopsis: While a private investigator probes the disappearance of the young heir to a powerful fishery, he finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.

releases.title: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass
releases.synopsis: During a chase inside a museum, Tom and Jerry find an ancient magical compass and end up being transported through time. Lost in a distant era, they will need to work together to find a way back home.

releases.title: The Restoration at Grayson Manor
releases.synopsis: The foundations of Grayson Manor are shaken when an accident leaves Boyd Grayson handless and his mother invests in radical new technology to help him.

releases.title: Final Table
releases.synopsis: The Table: K-Chef 2026 brings together Korea's top chefs to compete for the title of the country's best chef. Mysterious world-renowned chef Chris K., also known as Kang Han, Song-yi, who is fighting to save her restaurant, perfectionist star chef Woo-jin, and chefs with stories of their own face off in a fierce culinary battle. More than a competition, they find comfort in food and one another.

releases.title: The Gift of Deceit
releases.synopsis: Desperate to find a cure for the unknown illness affecting her daughter, art collector Lúcia Rossetti turns to a spiritual healer. When Lúcia falls victim to a scam, a series of secrets is revealed, intertwining two families marked by love, control, resentment, and guilt.

releases.title: Always Yours, Never Mine
releases.synopsis: Across thirty years, several almosts, and timing that is never quite right, two people keep crossing paths – always on the verge of being together, but never quite making it.

releases.title: 5 Centimeters per Second
releases.synopsis: After transferring to the same elementary school, Takaki and Akari become fast friends, bonding over the constant upheaval of moving from town to town. Just as their feelings for each other start to blossom, their shared happiness comes to an end when both of their families are forced to relocate. As the seasons change, Takaki and Akari begin to wonder if they will ever be able to see each other again, and share their secret feelings.

releases.title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
releases.synopsis: A powerful return to roots, this concert captures Black Sabbath in peak form - reuniting to deliver classic hits with raw energy and legendary precision.

releases.title: Minimum Wage
releases.synopsis: Teens struggle to run a local pizzeria while juggling school, a manic boss and minimum wage in this series based on the hit social media shorts.

releases.title: Shadows of the Ten Ninja
releases.synopsis: When Ieyasu Tokugawa declares war on the Toyotomi, the Sanada Ten Braves come together in a decisive battle against the current ruler of Japan.

releases.title: The Fall of El Mayo
releases.synopsis: Co-founder of the Sinaloa Cartel, longtime partner of "El Chapo", and a ghost to authorities for over three decades. The documentary that tells the story of his downfall.

releases.title: Balaraw: Blood Island
releases.synopsis: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

releases.title: The One About Matthew Perry
releases.synopsis: Told through intimate testimonies from close family and friends, this documentary event reveals the real Matthew Perry—generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life—and the battles he fought to become the man behind the icon. A raw record of a life lived in full, and the honesty that became his greatest legacy.

releases.title: Fading Grandeur
releases.synopsis: Desperate to sell his crumbling mansion, a fallen marquis tries to make a quick deal with a charming yet mysterious millionaire who has her own agenda.

releases.title: Newlyweds
releases.synopsis: A mature romance about a free-spirited woman and a reserved professor who marry quickly after a brief, passionate courtship.

releases.title: The Mob
releases.synopsis: Celebrities compete in mob-themed challenges at an Italian villa for $250,000. They elect a don who controls eliminations and prize money. As power demands loyalty, contestants must decide whether to support the don or overthrow them.

releases.title: Udta Teer
releases.synopsis: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

releases.title: Breeder
releases.synopsis: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

releases.title: Chaar Yaar
releases.synopsis: A story of four middle-class boys, their dreams, setbacks and friendship being their armour. A fateful decision leads them to take a step that changes the course of their lives trapping them between gangsters and cops. What once held them together slowly tears their bond. With their armour shattered, their enemies close in and fate serves up a bill for their crimes.

releases.title: LOL: Last One Laughing Halloween UK
releases.synopsis: Last One Laughing is back…with a twist. Jimmy Carr is joined by 7 of the country's funniest people for a special Halloween-themed series and this time, there's no laughing OR screaming. Over the course of 4 hours, they will pull out all the stops to make each other crack…but who will last longest and take home the trophy?

releases.title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
releases.synopsis: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

releases.title: Making Marie Antoinette
releases.synopsis: Eleanor Coppola turns her camera on her daughter, Sofia, as she shoots Marie Antoinette. Catching every detail of the behind-the-scenes and on-set action, Eleanor captures the feat of Sofia’s directing a landmark film aged 34, and muses on what it means for a mother to watch her daughter at work.

releases.title: The Narco Hack
releases.synopsis: An impenetrable encrypted messaging app becomes a safe haven for organised crime -- until French investigators hack their way in.

releases.title: Haiku
releases.synopsis: A charismatic young man uses poetry to navigate the complex maze of modern romance to protect his fragile relationship. Later, he must overcome deep generational divides to keep his love alive.

releases.title: Hostel Haadsa
releases.synopsis: A fearless skeptic unravels a haunted hostel's legend, only to become its next target.

releases.title: A Course Called Ireland
releases.synopsis: Bill Murray and friends go on an unpredictable road trip around the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland, playing their way across some of the island’s most legendary golf courses.

releases.title: The Wolves of Real Estate: The Alexander Brothers
releases.synopsis: Investigates how three successful brothers ascended in the elite world of luxury real estate and private security in Miami and New York, all while harboring an extremely dark secret.

releases.title: Tamil Idol
releases.synopsis: Tamil Idol is not just a singing show, it's The Largest Tamil Voice Movement Ever Attempted.​ Tamil Idol travels across Tamil Nadu and global Tamil communities, collecting voices, stories and musical identities. From lakhs of voices emerges one defining Tamil Idol.​

releases.title: Love Island Australia: Unseen. Uncut.
releases.synopsis: This season of Love Island Australia is getting VillaMaxxed with this new companion series. Direct from the Villa, drops of unseen and exclusive footage will give you VIP access to the Islanders - in real time, unfiltered and unpredictable.

releases.title: BTS: THE RETURN
releases.synopsis: They're back! BTS gathers in LA to record their album "Arirang" in this documentary offering unprecedented access to the band as they enter a new era.

releases.title: Cannibal Poet
releases.synopsis: A three-part miniseries investigating the case of José Luis Calva Zepeda, a notorious serial killer accused of cannibalizing his girlfriend.

releases.title: Tu Hai Meri Kiran
releases.synopsis: What starts as a real connection for her turns into his all-consuming obsession. As love darkens, the boundary between devotion and danger fades.

releases.title: Cars That Changed History
releases.synopsis:
Cars That Changed History is a 2026 documentary docuseries airing on National Geographic.

Format: 1-season docuseries consisting of 6 episodes exploring engineering breakthroughs, historic rivalries, and the social impact of iconic vehicles.
Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

releases.title: Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell
releases.synopsis: Instadocs goes inside the rape investigation and Jane Doe lawsuit at Cornell University, with the student journalists at the forefront of the story.

releases.title: Tum Mere Ho
releases.synopsis: Tum Mere Ho is a heartfelt romance starring Gurmeet Choudhary and Isha Malviya, exploring love, emotions, and the unexpected turns that bring two hearts together.

releases.title: Kordell Stewart / Slash & Burn
releases.synopsis: For a generation of football fans, former Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Kordell "Slash" Stewart was one of the most electrifying players of the 1990s. But just as he became one of football's biggest stars, a malicious rumor upended his life. Through candid interviews with Stewart and others who witnessed his brightest and darkest moments, explore the personal toll of scrutiny beyond the football field while searching for the truth behind a story that followed Stewart for decades.

releases.title: Udumbanchola Vision
releases.synopsis: When album designer Midhun takes over a struggling local TV channel, he uncovers a deadly rivalry behind its downfall. Using secrets and manipulation, he rises to power, but his ambition quickly turns to greed. Just as he dominates the industry, a dangerous international threat emerges.

releases.title: Magazine
releases.synopsis: Bored, privileged, and convinced his life has zero plot, a drama-hungry Gen Z cinephile leaves the city for his ancestral village in search of some main-character energy, hoping life will finally give him something worth talking about, but an unlikely friendship, a new world, and one unexpected twist soon turn his own life into the story he's been waiting for.

releases.title: Dot to Dot: Will I Be Single Forever?
releases.synopsis: Misaki Yamada, 30 and single, has no clear ambitions. After drifting between jobs and places, she works as a care worker until trouble in love and work upends her life. Shiba, 38, avoids close relationships, but takes in his nephew and slowly bonds with him through Yamada. Shimizu, 46, faces caring for her father after years of putting work first. All three search for where they belong.

releases.title: The Last Drive-In with Joe Bob Briggs: Joe Bob's Halloween House Party
releases.synopsis: Joe Bob Briggs hosts a Halloween double feature, with his usual behind-the-scenes commentary and drive-in totals.

releases.title: Open House Outrageous
releases.synopsis: Interior designer Megan Batoon and comedian Tim Chantarangsu taking exciting tours of unusual vacation homes and distinctive stays in destinations.

releases.title: Zainab Johnson: Toxically Optimistic
releases.synopsis: Zainab Johnson has a gun revelation, a Tesla crisis and an unshakable belief that she can find the upside in everything in this sharp stand-up hour.

releases.title: LARA - The Man Who Took on Escobar
Dhood (Sandstorm)
releases.synopsis: Set against the vast expanse of the Thar desert, an isolated family's desperate wishes and psychological friction trigger a dark domestic countdown, threatening to reduce their household entirely into dust

releases.title: Doosra
releases.synopsis: The 2002 NatWest Final was more than a cricketing victory for India. It was a moment when a nation found its voice, and a young girl found the courage to speak her truth.

releases.title: Deviant
releases.synopsis: After a successful video date, Brooklyn invites Cameron over to her rented Airbnb in Joshua Tree to take things to the next level. Their evening soon gets interrupted by a masked intruder who takes them captive with mysterious intentions. To survive the night, they're forced to confront a sordid past that reveals a disturbing connection.

releases.title: Damned
releases.synopsis: A social-media influencer goes in search of an old, forgotten folk singer Naseem Bano, whose claim to fame was an off-hand compliment from Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan in 1988. He wants her to sing for his Instagram feed but she has forgotten herself. Late at night, when the whole hospital sleeps, she has a flash of memory.

releases.title: Udgam: The Origin of Life
releases.synopsis: Set in Chamba, the film follows community worker Rena and local farmers preserving indigenous seeds and traditional farming knowledge amid changing agriculture, water scarcity and uncertain rainfall. Their efforts reveal how seed conservation can protect biodiversity and support climate-resilient livelihoods.

releases.title: Little Thomas
releases.synopsis: In early 1990s Goa, seven year old Thomas and his family navigate thr ups and downs in their lives.

releases.title: Tammy Pescatelli: Mrs. Saturday Night
releases.synopsis: Watch Tammy Pescatelli deliver her hilarious stand-up comedy special, Mrs. Saturday Night, filmed live at the Triad Theater. 😂  Tammy takes the stage in New York City to share her brutally honest take on everyday life. Known for her fearless storytelling and sharp observational comedy, she turns relatable situations into a non-stop series of laughs.  This full comedy special captures Tammy Pescatelli at her best, with an energetic delivery that keeps the audience engaged from start to finish. If you enjoy bold, unfiltered humor from one of the sharpest voices in the industry, this set is for you. 🎤

releases.title: Border Diaries
releases.synopsis: Set in an industrial area on the Karnataka-Tamil Nadu border, the story explores the lives of people working there and focuses on emotional borders, love, morality, and survival.

releases.title: PAPER GIRL
releases.synopsis: A struggling writer, unable to find the confidence to finish his story, brings a character to life on the page. As the story unfolds, the girl he created becomes an unexpected source of inspiration, leading him to rediscover the creative conviction he had once lost.

releases.title: The Remarried Empress
releases.synopsis: Beloved Empress Navier rules the Eastern Empire alongside Emperor Sovieshu. But when Sovieshu falls for a runaway slave and demands a divorce, Navier will agree on one condition: that she's given approval to remarry rival Prince Heinrey of the Western Kingdom.

releases.title: A Story of Derry
releases.synopsis: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

releases.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
releases.synopsis: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

releases.title: The Mongoose
releases.synopsis: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

releases.title: Dead-End Job
releases.synopsis: Drowning in debt, a young man takes lucrative part-time jobs from a mysterious agency — only to find his hustle for more money turning nightmarish.

releases.title: A Dog's Perfect Christmas
releases.synopsis: When a medical emergency pulls the Goss family apart, determined dog Winstead will do all he can to bring his humans back together before Christmas Eve.

releases.title: Collision Course
releases.synopsis: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

releases.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
releases.synopsis: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

releases.title: Scene
releases.synopsis: Inbaraj, a police officer, is forced to come back from retirement when a new case resembles one he closed years ago. This time, he must solve it with a chaotic and troublesome team. As they struggle to work together and deal with the twists and turns of the case, the investigation takes them on a chaotic and unpredictable ride.

releases.title: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
releases.synopsis: Given a year to live, frugal 40-year-old Yui finally lets herself spend: "buying" nightclub host Sena. What begins as a contract takes an unexpected turn.

releases.title: Akka
releases.synopsis: In a kingdom ruled by women, matriarch Bhavani faces her biggest threat in Rudra, a ruthless rebel eyeing her land and legacy.

releases.title: The Greatest
releases.synopsis: Fresh off gold at the 1960 Olympics, young boxer Muhammad Ali (then known as Cassius Clay) sets his sights on the Heavyweight Championship. Contending with newfound fame, self-doubt, family conflict and a politically charged America, the once-in-a-generation prodigy discovers his greatest opponent won't be in the ring, but in a society that isn't ready for him to become his own man.

releases.title: Bass X Machina
releases.synopsis: In a steampunk West overrun by outlaws, machines and supernatural forces, a father is forced to become judge, jury and executioner to protect his family.

releases.title: Christmas at the Kringles
releases.synopsis: After moving to a quiet suburban neighborhood, the Seversons meet the Kringles, a family that celebrates Christmas year-round. When Mark, the father, discovers the Kringles' sinister yuletide intentions, he teams up with a badass Santa in a high-stakes, action-packed fight to save his family.

releases.title: Overacting
releases.synopsis: When her father's memories as a retired top cop resurface, a struggling actress stages wild missions to keep him from pursuing his elusive archnemesis.

releases.title: Barbie in the Nutcracker
releases.synopsis: Barbie “Brooklyn” Roberts steps into the role of the Sugarplum Princess and Barbie “Malibu” Roberts stars as Clara, as they journey through a musical, magical dreamworld filled with holiday wonder, courage and friendship.

releases.title: Frequency of Fear
releases.synopsis: In September 2024, a covert Israeli operation took aim at decimating Islamist militant group Hezbollah, in which thousands of pagers and walkie-talkies in the possession of its operatives exploded simultaneously in Lebanon.

releases.title: Anaesthesia
releases.synopsis: After a bold but unsuccessful surgery, a talented doctor swaps a prestigious clinic for a local hospital as he tries to get his life back on track.

releases.title: The Perfect Lie
releases.synopsis: After a heart-fluttering date, Joonho, a heart surgeon with a perfect smile, and Jisun, a free-spirited teacher-librarian, share a special night. The next day, they meet at a police station with completely different memories. A shocking polygraph result turns their lives upside down.

releases.title: Sight & Sound Presents: JOSHUA—Live!
releases.synopsis: Journey alongside the people of Israel as they navigate their new-found freedom in an unforgiving wilderness. When Joshua is called to replace Moses as their faithful leader, tensions mount in the midst of dwindling supplies and approaching armies. With one last fortified city standing between the Israelites and the Promised Land, unexpected help emerges from behind enemy lines and Joshua's trust in God's plan is put to the ultimate test.  Filmed in front of a live audience, this special event invites you to experience one of the most redemptive stories of the Bible come to life like never before!

releases.title: A Couple of Lies
releases.synopsis: A seemingly idyllic home swap between Sicily and Stockholm turns toxic as two wealthy couples go to extremes to protect themselves — and their secrets.

releases.title: The 12 Dates of Christmas
releases.synopsis: Christina Walker, a successful shop owner who has devoted her energy to her career at the expense of her dating life, goes on 12 dates in the 12 weeks leading up to Christmas hoping to find Mr. Right.

releases.title: The Birthday​ Gift​
releases.synopsis: Single mother Marlene Frischmann organizes a birthday party for her son Theo at her brother's chic country villa, which quickly spirals into family drama, world-view quarrels, and chaos.

releases.title: Meethe Mein Kya Hai
releases.synopsis: A young widower's grief eases at a joyful Diwali reunion — until his sister's surprise marriage throws the family into chaos.

releases.title: Rudravanam PS
releases.synopsis: An honest police officer, SI Siva kumar, investigates a mysterious disappearance and a gruesome headless corpse in a small town.

releases.title: Taken: Natalee Holloway
releases.synopsis: Beth Holloway, Natalee's mother, tells the full, definitive story of the case that's haunted her for the past 20 years - from the day of Natalee's disappearance to the dramatic confession two decades later.

releases.title: Ninho: Fame Ain’t Worth It
releases.synopsis: At the height of his success in 2025, French rap star Ninho considers leaving music behind. This documentary looks back on the triumphs, sacrifices and personal challenges that brought him to that crossroads.

releases.title: Obsess
releases.synopsis: After returning home, Talal is pulled into a dark psychological journey where the lines between guilt, desire and his own disturbing impulses begin to blur. As buried feelings connected to a past love resurface, the darkness inside him grows stronger. Talal is forced to confront a terrifying question: can he free himself from his past, or will it consume him completely?

releases.title: Everest: The Other Side
releases.synopsis: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

releases.title: The Last Temptation of Becky
releases.synopsis: Now working as a field agent for the CIA, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf's Lair, Hitler's WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

releases.title: The Mosquito Bowl
releases.synopsis: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

releases.title: High End: The Watch Theft Ring
releases.synopsis: Investigates Chile's high-profile Caso Relojes ("Watch Case") scandal, in which a suitcase full of smuggled luxury watches and jewelry unmasked an illicit underground network, connecting criminal elements to Chile's social elite.

releases.title: Terrell & T.O.
releases.synopsis: This feature-length documentary traces the meteoric rise of one of the most talented, accomplished, and polarizing athletes of America's most popular sport and examines his role as the preeminent "prima donna" wide receiver of his era, while catching up with Owens in present-day to see how he is evolving and discovering a new personal path forward.

releases.title: Gentle Monster
releases.synopsis: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

releases.title: How to Ruin Diwali: Meet the Parents
releases.synopsis: When overachieving perfectionist Mmabatho Nkomo meets her fiancé’s traditional Indian family for the first time, her desperate attempt to make a good impression goes badly wrong. She accidentally exposes her future father-in-law’s secret affair. With Diwali only days away, Mmabatho must navigate unfamiliar cultural territory and try to reunite the family she has torn apart — without creating even more chaos.

releases.title: Tony Xavier
releases.synopsis: A Chartered Accountant who acknowledges that his death is close at hand and becomes isolated in life altogether, loses his mental state and seeks refuge in the pleasure of eliminating the happiness of people around him forever, with a pinch of sadistic desires.

releases.title: Queen at Sea
releases.synopsis: As advanced dementia erodes an older woman's ability to communicate her inner life, her husband and daughter struggle to act in her best interests, navigating love and the fragile boundaries between care, protection and autonomy.

releases.title: Dilwali Diwali
releases.synopsis: Ansh Sikkha returns to his Punjabi family home for Diwali after years working abroad. As the Sikkas gather for the festival, their clashing views on what constitutes a fulfilling life create friction and connection.

releases.title: Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 - AK47
releases.synopsis: A tight-knit family faces an unexpected crisis that threatens their bond, forcing them to re-evaluate their values and fight to stay united.

releases.title: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
releases.synopsis: Second City Television cast members reunite in this documentary for a funny and heartfelt celebration of how a scrappy Canadian sketch show made comedy history.

releases.title: Mike Tyson: Return of the Mike
releases.synopsis: The former heavyweight champion returns to the stage for a raw one-man show, turning his wildest life stories into comedy gold at Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino.

releases.title: Pyre
releases.synopsis: In the Himalayan Mountain range, a rural village loses its inhabitants to the city’s allure while an elderly couple, Padam Singh and Tulsi, live in desolate isolation. Their days are filled with routine and occasional humour as they mask their loneliness. Their son’s absence gnaws at them, and when a letter arrives promising his return, it reignites their hearts with joy and anticipation. However, the reunion does not unfold as expected, shattering their hopes. As the film climaxes, the spectator is confronted with a more rueful plight, deeply engaging the audience’s empathy.

releases.title: On Behalf of My Son
releases.synopsis: Vicentina struggles to cope with the death of her son Wesley after a tragic bus accident, in which he was the driver. As the investigation unfolds, evidence suggests that Wesley’s actions may have been suicidal. Vicentina then embarks on a journey to seek out the victims’ families and apologize, while confronting her own grief and uncertainty.

releases.title: Ralph's Perfekt Christmas
releases.synopsis: To win back his wife, Christmas-obsessed Ralph concocts a crazy plan to kidnap the washed-up child star of his favorite Christmas movie. His scheme goes awry and spirals darkly out of control in an outrageous dark comedy with a horror twist that reveals two sides of one very desperate man determined to have his "Perfekt Christmas," no matter what - even if it lands him on the Naughty List.

releases.title: Last Stream
releases.synopsis: Desperate for views, a fading streamer stages a fake haunting connected to an unsolved case. The stream spirals into a real-time nightmare watched by tens of thousands and someone in the chat seems to know exactly how the night will end.

releases.title: The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE - Yotsuba Succession Arc -
releases.synopsis: The invitation has arrived. It's time for the New Year's Reception at the Yotsuba family residence. This year, Miyuki and other candidates will gather there to decide who will be the next leader of their powerful clan. If chosen as successor, she would never again have to see her brother live as an outcast. At the same time, such a position would surely entail a political marriage, leaving her mind in complete turmoil. To complicate matters, the current head of the family sows doubt with a shocking statement. When the new year arrives, their relationship may change forever...

releases.title: Castration Movie Chapter iii. Junior Ghosts—Premorphic Drift; a fragmentary passage
releases.synopsis: Izzy does everything in her power to stop her partner from transitioning.

releases.title: Enemy Of The Smuggler
releases.synopsis: Inspired by real customs investigations, a relentless battle unfolds against organized smuggling networks, exposing the hidden world of coastal operations, airport cartels and the officers determined to stop them.

releases.title: #Cult
releases.synopsis: A group of young boys head to a party expecting a night of fun, but soon discover the reality is far darker than they imagined. What starts as excitement spirals into terror, pushing them into a brutal fight for survival.

releases.title: In Transit
releases.synopsis: When a complacent young bartender living in small-town Maine agrees to model for a existentially floundering painter on an artist's retreat, both women must confront their preconceptions of what makes a good life.

releases.title: OJ's Accomplice
releases.synopsis: While the world was distracted by the media circus around O.J. Simpson's trial, they might have ignored a chilling possibility: he may have had help.

releases.title: Nakhrewaalii
releases.synopsis: Sumit Mishra cross-dresses as a woman to win over his love interest, Paridhi.

releases.title: Desperately Devoted
releases.synopsis: Teri Hatcher reunites with her former on-screen daughter Andrea Bowen and her real-life daughter Emerson Tenney to revisit Desperate Housewives, reflecting on its most memorable storylines, characters and behind-the-scenes moments.

releases.title: Jennifer
releases.synopsis: Jennifer is an Indian movie directed by Althaf Rahman starring Swasika. The feature film is produced by Antony Naduvattom and Binu Dev

releases.title: Pulavar
releases.synopsis: A unique retired police officer uses storytelling and his understanding of the human mind to uncover the truth behind crimes committed by criminals who refuse to confess, even after facing beatings and threats.

releases.title: Spring
releases.synopsis: A young couple's peaceful getaway to a remote hilltop bungalow takes a terrifying turn as mysterious events unfold. As hidden secrets emerge, their seemingly perfect life is threatened by fear and suspense.

releases.title: Pani Vizhum Iravu
releases.synopsis: During a trip to a century-old Kodaikanal bungalow, JK reports his lover Shabi mysteriously missing, triggering a tense police inquiry entangled with an unsolved murder, suspicious staff, and local thieves. However, as the investigation deepens, the boundary between reality and illusion shatters, exposing a harrowing confrontation with unresolved grief, guilt, and the fragile human mind.

releases.title: Love Story Abhimanyu Ki
releases.synopsis: Torn between her first love, Wasim Akhtar, and Abhimanyu Yadav, whom her family pressures her to marry, a simple girl faces a complex journey. Struggling with personal trauma and social expectations, she must navigate her emotions to choose her own path.

releases.title: Patakka Guddiyan
releases.synopsis: Roohi, a simple girl, is the complete opposite of her twin sister Mahi, who is sharp, daring, and mischievous. As the story progresses, layers of suspense and drama unfold.

releases.title: Singgaramm
releases.synopsis: An ordinary man finds himself cornered by a world that demands his surrender. Refusing to bow down, he summons the courage to stand his ground and sets out on a path that will rewrite his destiny.

releases.title: Amazon Music Live: Doja Cat
releases.synopsis: Doja Cat Performing The Vie Tour Live At The Forum.

releases.title: Frozen: Biggest Sledding Adventure Ever!
releases.synopsis: Snow has arrived in Arendelle, and Anna and Olaf are excited for their first sled ride of the winter! When the hills aren't thrilling enough, Elsa uses her ice magic to create an epic sledding course filled with giant jumps, twists, and icy surprises. But when royal duties call Elsa away, Anna and Olaf come up with a special plan to bring the winter fun back and surprise their sister.

releases.title: Sei Seyyadhe
releases.synopsis: A Tamil social-awareness drama built around a message-driven narrative, this film aims to bring an important social conversation to the big screen, encouraging audiences to reflect on the choices society makes.

releases.title: Geriga
releases.synopsis: In the remote village of Naivad, Kerala, villagers follow GERIGA, a sacred ritual to summon the dead. Desperate for viral fame, Vijay and his four YouTuber friends stage the ritual as a hoax, but horror strikes when Vijay is possessed just as news breaks of his father's sudden death. Now, the group must fight supernatural forces and finish the ritual in twelve days to free him before time runs out.

releases.title: Kadhal Bodhai
releases.synopsis: Saravanan, a simple villager, faces tragedy when his friends and fellow villagers die after consuming alcohol during a festival. With his daughter's help, he confronts his mistakes and resolves to give up drinking.

releases.title: Nightblade
releases.synopsis: The Nightblade Killer is on the loose during the night of a full moon.

releases.title: Pass the Salt
releases.synopsis: Parmiss falls for her new roomie Nava, while escaping her overbearing Iranian family.

releases.title: Mr. Lucky
releases.synopsis: Lakshman, an IT professional ironically nicknamed Lucky, finds himself trapped in a life full of misfortune. Everything changes when a mysterious cap turns his luck around, taking his life in unexpected directions.

releases.title: Manduka
releases.synopsis: A girl suffering from schizophrenia accidentally meets four criminals. Meanwhile in an hide and seek with Police and the criminals lies the mystery.

releases.title: Jaunt
releases.synopsis: In a stark warehouse office, Justice is weighed down by mounting deadlines and an endless to-do list. But every day, he finds escape in a one-hour ritual that reignites his spirit.

releases.title: Wild Horse Nine
releases.synopsis: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

releases.title: Campus Drivers
releases.synopsis: Lois arrives in Belrose with Max, the love of her life. Lane, the creator of Campus Drivers, the hottest app on campus, is known for never getting attached. Their paths were never meant to cross. But some encounters change everything, reopening old wounds. And when love appears unexpectedly, nothing is certain anymore.

releases.title: Ghost Soldier
releases.synopsis: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

releases.title: The Body
releases.synopsis: On Halloween night, an all-girls dance squad tumbles into Catholic guilt, unholy desires and ghostly visions when an initiation goes to hell.

releases.title: De Gaulle: Résistance
releases.synopsis: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.

releases.title: The Cat in the Hat
releases.synopsis: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

releases.title: Mookuthi Amman 2
releases.synopsis: A queen sacrifices herself to protect her son, the prince, from invading enemies.Mookuthi Amman returns to protect the child and confronts a mysterious woman who embodies a new and dangerous evil.

releases.title: Drummer Boy
releases.synopsis: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family search for freedom. Through battle and loss, music carries hope in a deeply human story of faith and forgiveness.

releases.title: Raise the Red Lantern
releases.synopsis: In 1920s China, 19-year-old Songlian becomes a concubine of a powerful lord and is forced to compete with his three wives for the privileges gained.

releases.title: The Gospel of Christmas
releases.synopsis: A struggling pastor moves his family to a troubled New York neighborhood, where they must save a neglected church from foreclosure before Christmas.

releases.title: Under Siege
releases.synopsis: Caught in the crossfire, hostages, militaries and guerrillas are swept into a tragedy that brings turmoil to Colombia.

releases.title: Jimmy
releases.synopsis: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

releases.title: Miracles of the ER
releases.synopsis: A bold decision brings an average med student to an elite ER team, where he encounters medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and personal growth.

releases.title: The Good Daughter
releases.synopsis: Sisters Charlotte and Samantha Quinn have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte is the first witness on the scene. Now a lawyer like her father, she’s forced to confront her own demons as the case twists through one shocking revelation after another. In the end, both she and Samantha find themselves wondering if the price of being the good daughter was worth it after all.

releases.title: I Play Rocky
releases.synopsis: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

releases.title: Alicia's Law
releases.synopsis: When her carefully built life comes undone, Alicia returns to practicing law and discovers that rebuilding her career also means redefining herself.

releases.title: Devils' Crest
releases.synopsis: Yuma Ashihara was set to enjoy a test session of Actual Magic (AM)—the world's first fulldive VRMMO-RPG—together with his classmates Sawa Ashihara, Kenji Kondo, and Minagi Sano. The plan was simple: defeat the boss as a party of four, log out, and finish the test play safely — or at least, that's how it was supposed to go.

releases.title: ChiaroScuro
releases.synopsis: After a body is found in a Roman museum, an art expert must apply his instincts and skills to help police solve a mystery connected to his own past.

A heist takes 12 months to plan, 12 hours to execute—and a thief not caught within 12 days won't be caught at all. Across three pulse-pounding timelines, an FBI agent and a career criminal face off in a deadly game of cat and mouse through Europe.

releases.title: Unprotected: Murder in Galicia
releases.synopsis: Documentary film that tells the story of Isabel Fuentes. In April 2015, alleged burglars left her on the brink of death in her own home, in the village of Pazos, in Verín. From the very beginning, the Guardia Civil sergeant in charge of the case suspected that the account of what had happened did not add up and tried to protect Isabel from further attack.

releases.title: Mouse
releases.synopsis: When her closest friendship is suddenly disrupted the summer before senior year, a teenager struggles to find her footing and develops an unexpected, complicated bond with her best friend’s mother.

releases.title: DNK
releases.synopsis: A young man with a compulsive stealing habit brings trouble upon his family, who must deal with the consequences of his actions.

releases.title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
releases.synopsis: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

releases.title: Melania Rea
releases.synopsis: The tragic story of Melania Rea, whose case reveals a toxic marriage marked by lies and manipulation.

releases.title: Club Kid
releases.synopsis: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

releases.title: Daffy Season
releases.synopsis: Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.

releases.title: Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook
releases.synopsis: Hollywood actor and comedian Nora Lum (a.k.a. Awkwafina) is the descendant of restaurant royalty...but she can't cook. Join the star on an inspiring culinary road trip as she learns the craft and attempts to revive her family's beloved Chinese eatery.

releases.title: The Unthinkable Daughter
releases.synopsis: Decades of questions and a crime that shook Brazil. Suzane von Richthofen, convicted for the murder of her parents, tells the whole story in her own words.

releases.title: Avedon
releases.synopsis: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon's archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

releases.title: Disco
releases.synopsis: An ordinary man undergoes a transformation as he enters the dark and dangerous world of the underworld.

releases.title: Doozie's Doghouse
releases.synopsis: Make it a doghouse day! Dog-loving Doozie uses her creativity and imagination during playtime with her puppy pals.

releases.title: Being Heumann
releases.synopsis: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

releases.title: Kauriburir Mandir
releases.synopsis: When a mysterious curse threatens the woman he once loved, astrologer Bhabataran enters a haunted wilderness where an ancient cult worships a bloodthirsty deity. As a forbidden ritual draws near, he must confront a terrifying legacy buried for centuries.

releases.title: Get Huge: Looksmaxxing to Death
releases.synopsis: An unflinching portrait of masculinity in the influencer age, where extreme biohacking, online performance and a series of suspicious deaths converge.

releases.title: Nooru Kodi Vaanavil
releases.synopsis: Vino and Fenny's lives intertwine in a poignant tale of love, hope, and heartbreak.

releases.title: Oxytoxin
releases.synopsis: The elite, popular girls known as Toxxxxin rule the school, but an unexpected bond with a scholarship student could unravel their carefully kept secrets.

releases.title: Blind Game
releases.synopsis: A suspended police officer tracks down a missing fortune and a dangerous secret.

releases.title: Kauriburi: The Cursed Temple
releases.synopsis: When a mysterious curse threatens the woman he once loved, astrologer Bhabataran enters a haunted wilderness where an ancient cult worships a bloodthirsty deity. As a forbidden ritual draws near, he must confront a terrifying legacy buried for centuries.

releases.title: Janelle James: How Romantic
releases.synopsis: In her debut hour-long stand-up special, Janelle James sounds off on body counts, bank accounts and why women should wrestle men.

releases.title: Style Wars
releases.synopsis: 72 fashion fanatics face off on a stage where looks, age, profession, experience, and fame mean absolutely nothing compared to the fit. Who will rise to the top? Let the fashion survival games begin!

releases.title: Big Bargain Holiday Showdown
releases.synopsis: Follows teams of friends, family and neighbors competing to transform a room in their home into a holiday wonderland in 48 hours on a $500 budget, judged for a chance to win cash prizes.

releases.title: The Invisible Guest
releases.synopsis: Accused of murdering her lover, a young businesswoman hires a brilliant lawyer. With only three hours left, they must uncover what really happened.

releases.title: Bouma
releases.synopsis: A struggling singer returns to an isolated, secret-shrouded estate tied to her own forgotten past. Simultaneously, a police investigation into a series of missing women intersects with the estate, blurring past memories and active crime.

releases.title: Summer Holidays
releases.synopsis: A city boy's summer at his grandparents' Godavari village transforms when he befriends a spirited local paper boy. Together they explore rural life through adventures that forge an unforgettable childhood bond.

releases.title: Lakadbaggha 2: The Monkey Business
releases.synopsis: Sequel to Lakadbaggha (2023). Plot TBA.

releases.title: Motu Patlu & the Mystery of Nagmani
releases.synopsis: Motu and Patlu chase John into a time portal after he steals a precious diamond locket, sending them 900 years into the past into the ancient city of Andherius.

releases.title: Tadej Pogacar: Anatomy of a G.O.A.T.
releases.synopsis: Through expert analysis and first-hand insights, this documentary examines the genetics, mindset and team support that have helped make Tadej Pogačar one of cycling's most successful riders.

releases.title: Saheb's stolen Redmi
releases.synopsis: When Saheb loses his beloved Redmi phone, a precious gift from his girlfriend, he is left devastated. Desperate to get it back, he seeks help from his three friends—Lal, Bahadur and Shastri. Despite their initial reluctance, the trio joins him in a chaotic search filled with hilarious encounters and unexpected drama. When their efforts fail, they turn to Baba, a quirky astrologer, for help. Eventually, they find the damaged phone and visit a mechanic, who suggests an unusual alternative: stealing a phone from the notorious Lambu Don. What follows is a madcap adventure of comedy, drama and dance, leading to an unexpected twist!

releases.title: Bhāvāntara
releases.synopsis: Rooted in real-world human emotions and sacred traditions, a poignant story unfolds around the transgender experience, blending scripted narrative with unscripted footage from the vibrant Koovagam Festival.

releases.title: El último rescate en la Patagonia
releases.synopsis: In the heart of the arid Patagonian desert, a mission as improbable as it is urgent comes to life: to rescue two fossilized dinosaur nests that could contain intact embryos. Boris, director of the paleontological museum in Lamarque—a small town in the remote Middle Valley of Río Negro—leads this unique expedition.

releases.title: Ebenezer
