releases.synopsis: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

releases.title: How to Rob a Bank
releases.synopsis: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

releases.title: Bitter Christmas
releases.synopsis: During a long December holiday weekend, a woman, whose mother has recently died, throws herself into work as a form of escape. Her relentless pace is interrupted when a panic attack forces her to take a break.

releases.title: Victorian Psycho
releases.synopsis: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

releases.title: Agent Zeta
releases.synopsis: Four Spanish ex-intelligence officers are assassinated simultaneously worldwide. The CNI discovers all participated in the covert "Operation Ciénaga" decades ago in Colombia. Zeta, the CNI's best operative, must hunt and protect the sole survivor, facing his deadliest global mission yet. Top Colombian agent Alfa will join Zeta, seemingly knowing more about "Ciénaga"'s secrets than him.

releases.title: Paper Tiger
releases.synopsis: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

releases.title: The Countess of Monte Cristo
releases.synopsis: 1815. When her fiancé is wrongfully imprisoned and her rescue attempt ends in tragedy, Mercédès vows revenge against those who destroyed her life.

releases.title: Madden
releases.synopsis: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

releases.title: Being Heumann
releases.synopsis: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

releases.title: Heartland
releases.synopsis: A former country star, Misty Jones, comes out of seclusion to investigate the disappearance of her missing niece, a rising country musician and must grapple with her own past and Nashville’s seedy underbelly. Her search uncovers a murky side of Nashville where no one, including Misty, is who they seem.

releases.title: The Altruists
releases.synopsis: The story of Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison, two hyper-smart, ambitious young idealists who tried to remake the global financial system in the blink of an eye - before they were accused of stealing $8 billion and became Gen Z's own Bonnie & Clyde.

releases.title: Daayra
releases.synopsis: Raman, who has had a shady record with staged encounters and police brutality, finds himself cornered as Ajooni challenges him on every step.

releases.title: Guarding Stars
releases.synopsis: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

releases.title: Murder in Galicia
releases.synopsis: In Pazos, Irene is brutally attacked, and Civil Guard sergeant Elías suspects her husband Aniceto, racing against time to uncover the truth before it’s too late.

releases.title: Gentle Monster
releases.synopsis: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

releases.title: Itllu Arjuna
releases.synopsis: A mute man with exceptional skills falls in love, proving that true feelings do not always need words.

releases.title: Gordon
releases.synopsis: In this series, based on the book by Marcelo Larraquy, the thief Aníbal Gordon transforms into a murderer during the violent Argentina of the 1970s.

releases.title: Traces of Justice
releases.synopsis: The film follows criminal police officer Cui Xun over half a century of investigative work. Alongside his colleagues, he solved numerous major cases while staying true to his original aspiration of 'serving the people.' This legendary detective not only witnessed the evolution of China's public security system but also stood as a living testament to the rise of New China.

releases.title: KILL/SAVE
releases.synopsis: In a locked-down megacity where reality is optional, a lonely programmer risks his mind to rescue his girlfriend from a virtual prison — only to face a truth that challenges the very meaning of salvation and free will.

releases.title: ENE Repeat
releases.synopsis: A close-knit group of friends embark on another unforgettable journey, where old memories, new adventures, and unexpected twists test their friendship.

releases.title: Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy
releases.synopsis: Eager to get off Santa's naughty list, Snoopy goes all out to be the nicest beagle in town.

releases.title: A Proud Family Wizmas
releases.synopsis: When Penny Proud’s rant about Wizmas and the commercialization of Christmas causes Santa to quit on Christmas eve, Penny finds herself guilted into putting on the red suit and replacing him. And in the process of delivering Yuletide cheer with the help of Santa’s irreverent elves, she discovers that indeed the Christmas spirit is still alive.

releases.title: Win the Mall
releases.synopsis: Ten teams move into a mall where they must conquer storefronts, forge alliances and outsmart rivals to win $1 million in this reality competition series.

releases.title: God with Us
releases.synopsis: In an urban Maryland neighborhood, virginal Mary Anne Thomas and her boyfriend Joseph 'Junie' Love find their lives turned upside down when Mary discovers she’s miraculously pregnant without ever being with a man. As disbelief, danger, and divine destiny converge, their love is tested in a community desperate for hope.

releases.title: The First Five Minutes... The Title Design Legacy of Dan Perri
releases.synopsis: An in-depth exploration into the life of Dan Perri, the man who created titles for some of the most iconic movies of all time.

releases.title: The Body in the Locker
releases.synopsis: When Amy, the CEO of a major charity, loses her father, she's shocked to discover he owned a mysterious storage locker with a deadly secret inside - the body of a woman. Was her father a murderer? Who was this woman?

releases.title: Dead of Night
releases.synopsis: A small town is terrorized by a series of brutal murders, as a determined sheriff, his daughter, and a desperate mayor race to uncover the truth behind the killings before the town descends into chaos.

releases.title: Quarter
releases.synopsis: Kelly, a young woman living with Type 1 diabetes, is about to turn 25, as she deals with the ups and downs of her blood sugar levels and the ups and downs of her personal life.

releases.title: Alice in Wonderland –Dive in Wonderland–
releases.synopsis: The main character is a modern girl named Rise. One day, she wanders into Wonderland, and when she meets Alice, the story begins to unfold.

releases.title: Bandra
releases.synopsis: A woman uncovers a dark tale when she investigates the mysterious death of a famous actress.

releases.title: The Circle
releases.synopsis: This social experiment brings together everyday players and celebrities to compete side by side in a game of popularity where identity is ever-changing, and anyone can be anyone. Filmed in real time, the series gives viewers exclusive access as twists and player ratings unfold, with audience votes shaping the game. This fresh take supercharges the original's signature mix of strategy and deception into an addictive experience built for today's always-on audience.

releases.title: ROCK PAPER LANDMINE
releases.synopsis: Glico, Daruma-san ga Koronda... A game everyone knows—transformed into the ultimate battle of wits!?

releases.title: Silent Night
releases.synopsis:
Christmas Eve, 1976. Snow, silence, darkness. Three young people—a pregnant woman, her husband, and his younger brother—are killed by a bus while on their way to Midnight Mass.

No one saw anything. Or perhaps no one wants to talk. Instead of answers, there is a wall of silence. The incident is officially ruled an accident. But the victims’ mother and a young police officer named Maczek refuse to believe it was just a coincidence. He risks his career; she risks everything she has left. The deeper they dig, the more shocking revelations come to light. And the truth? It might just prove to be worse than the lie.

releases.title: Dark Noon
releases.synopsis: Caught in a cycle of petty crime and imprisonment, a man is released from prison for a failed bank robbery attempt while an impending solar eclipse offers a way out of the cycle.

releases.title: Remember
releases.synopsis: An estranged couple who have forgotten what it means to love each other find themselves pretending to be together again for the sake of their daughter, whose memory is fading.

releases.title: Somos así
releases.synopsis: TV show starring the members of the Argentine streaming program "Nadie dice nada." Plot TBA.

releases.title: Mrigaya 1.5: The Hunt Continues
releases.synopsis: Officer-in-Charge Debanjan Dutta of the Kolkata Police and his team face mounting danger while investigating a gruesome crime that shakes their neighborhood. As twists derail the probe, a ruthless gang spreads chaos across the city. With tensions rising and violence erupting, the hunt intensifies.

releases.title: Black Gold
releases.synopsis: The value of human hair is skyrocketing day by day.  dark color, length, and strength of Indian women's hair are highly prized in the global market. Millions of dollars circulate in this industry, which is controlled by commercial mafias. It is a well-known fact that wherever there is money, bloodshed, rivalry, and envy inevitably follow

releases.title: Plucked
releases.synopsis: In Gilded Age New York, a rebellious woman seeking to divorce her emotionally unstable husband turns a seemingly civilised evening into a night of chaos and violence.

releases.title: When a Witness Recants
releases.synopsis: In 1983, author Ta-Nehisi Coates learned that a 14-year-old boy was murdered in his Baltimore middle school. Upon revisiting the case, he uncovers the truth: Three innocent teenagers were wrongfully convicted and spent 36 years in prison — creating a lasting impact on the accused, the witnesses, and their community.

releases.title: Crypto
releases.synopsis: The story revolves around an Italian mafia family that contacts the two sons of its late leader, who are living in Egypt, to inform them of their inheritance rights. However, two Egyptian men impersonate the heirs and travel to Italy, where they find themselves caught up in a series of unexpected situations and complications.

releases.title: V. Shantaram
releases.synopsis: Chronicles Shantaram Rajaram Vankudre, aka V. Shantaram, on his remarkable journey from the silent era through the advent of sound and colour, showcasing his evolution as one of India’s most influential filmmakers.

releases.title: Dark Chocolate
releases.synopsis: After a string of failures, "Fire Star" Yagna faces downfall. Banned by the Film Industry for his attitude, can the "one-hit wonder" make a comeback?

releases.title: Lambodhara 2.0
releases.synopsis: A young man is drawn into a revolutionary AI-powered game that promises true happiness, only to discover it is a hidden system designed to study and control human emotion.

releases.title: The Hotline
releases.synopsis: Portrait of an anonymous overdose hotline where people call before using, and volunteers stay on the line, racing against time, forging collective hope amid addiction.

releases.title: Russell Brand: Open Secret
releases.synopsis: Featuring inside voices and archive footage, providing insight into British comedian Russell Brand’s life and the investigation that started it all at The Times and The Sunday Times, through chief news correspondent Rosamund Urwin and investigations correspondent Charlotte Wace.

releases.title: Begni Ronger Alo
releases.synopsis: Manasi Sinha's third directorial feature.  This is a story of a mother and her daughter, a tale of love, memory, and the delicate bond of identity. This is a story of a relationship bathed in an indescribable light, Begni ronger alo.

releases.title: The Pursuit: F1 ACADEMY
releases.synopsis: Offering unparalleled behind-the-scenes access to the 2025 F1 ACADEMY season, follow a group of elite female drivers, including Doriane Pin, Maya Weug, Chloe Chambers and Alisha Palmowski, as they navigate the pressures of competition and the personal sacrifices required to break into one of the most demanding sports in the world.

releases.title: Disturbia
releases.synopsis: Before our very eyes a strange human-bird hybrid undergoes constant transformation to cope with the omnipresent tensions of economical, ideological, military, and climatic threats.

releases.title: Darius Rucker: They Called Me Hootie
releases.synopsis: Darius Rucker gets deeply personal about the cost of stardom, revealing his struggles with drugs and alcohol, the breakdown of his marriage and brushes with death. Through candid interviews with collaborators, friends and family, new footage from the road and in the studio as he records his forthcoming album and never-before-seen tape dating back to the start of Hootie & the Blowfish, this documentary traces the full journey of his extraordinary career, revealing a deeply personal story of ambition, resilience and reinvention.

releases.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
releases.synopsis: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

releases.title: All of a Sudden
releases.synopsis: Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.

releases.title: Minotaur
releases.synopsis: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

releases.title: Hexed
releases.synopsis: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

releases.title: Focker-in-Law
releases.synopsis: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

releases.title: Blade Runner 2099
releases.synopsis: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

releases.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
releases.synopsis: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

releases.title: Steps
releases.synopsis: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

releases.title: Elsinore
releases.synopsis: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

releases.title: Dig
releases.synopsis: Follow four women who work at an archeological dig in Greece. When the team uncovers a long-buried secret with the potential to rewrite history, they find themselves at the center of a high-stakes international conspiracy.

releases.title: Peppa Pig: Perfect Holiday
releases.synopsis: Peppa is disappointed when she learns her family vacation is canceled. However, a sudden storm blows a hot air balloon carrying Peppa, George, Granny Pig, and Grandpa Pig all the way to China

releases.title: The Mosquito Bowl
releases.synopsis: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

releases.title: Way of the Warrior Kid
releases.synopsis: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

releases.title: The Blue Road
releases.synopsis: Two detectives join forces when brutal murders and cryptic messages surface across borders — but the deadly truth lurks dangerously close.

releases.title: Fool Night
releases.synopsis: In a dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of transforming into a Spirit Flower — a plant into which humans transform. Should he continue living as a person, or discard his pain and start a new life as a plant? Which path would you choose in his situation?

releases.title: OM: Chapter 1
releases.synopsis: Follows a man who saves twenty woodcutters arrested by police in a forest in Tiruvannamalai.

releases.title: Josephine
releases.synopsis: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

releases.title: Hershey
releases.synopsis: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.

releases.title: Lilo & Scratch
releases.synopsis: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

releases.title: Clashing Through the Snow
releases.synopsis: After weather grounds all flights east for the holidays, two work rivals competing for the same job begrudgingly embark on a cross-country road trip that brings them closer together in ways they never imagined.

releases.title: Propeller One-Way Night Coach
releases.synopsis: During the golden age of aviation, a young airplane enthusiast and his mother embark on a cross-country journey to Hollywood—and their simple flight transforms into the trip of a lifetime.

releases.title: November 1963
releases.synopsis: Follows the 48 hours after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, the alleged involvement of Sam Giancana and the 'Chicago Outfit', and a supposed broken promise after the mob helped to get Kennedy elected.

releases.title: The Vile
releases.synopsis: Devoted wife and mother Amani, whose life begins to unravel when her husband returns home with a second wife and an unseen darkness infiltrates her life.

releases.title: The Trials of Karen Read
releases.synopsis: An accident, a deadly fight or an elaborate cover-up? This true-crime series digs into the murder trials of Karen Read that sparked viral conspiracies.

releases.title: On Behalf of My Son
releases.synopsis: Vicentina struggles to cope with the death of her son Wesley after a tragic bus accident, in which he was the driver. As the investigation unfolds, evidence suggests that Wesley’s actions may have been suicidal. Vicentina then embarks on a journey to seek out the victims’ families and apologize, while confronting her own grief and uncertainty.

releases.title: MELANIA the Series
releases.synopsis: Experience Melania Trump's transition to First Lady as she navigates the White House and puts her mission into action.

releases.title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
releases.synopsis: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

releases.title: Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping
releases.synopsis: 1982. When the matriarch of a Dutch hotel empire is kidnapped for ransom, her family launches a desperate effort to free her.

releases.title: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow
releases.synopsis: Oobah Butler sets his sights on the world’s biggest industries and most powerful institutions. To infiltrate the worlds of wine, wellness, royalty, and more, Oobah hatches elaborate and increasingly audacious schemes by gaming online reviews, assuming made-up personas, and launching fake companies with entirely bogus backstories.

releases.title: Hollywood Hells
releases.synopsis: When a struggling actress attends an exclusive Hollywood party, she discovers a cabal of power brokers who produce real-life snuff films for the elite. As she fights for her life in the shadowy underbelly of fame, she turns their own cameras against them—becoming not just a survivor, but the director of their final cut.

releases.title: Sathyavan Savithiri
releases.synopsis: Follows a cheerful lawyer whose life turns upside down when she takes up a major case while navigating her own emotional pain and fighting for social justice.

releases.title: Ash and Crayons
releases.synopsis: Seven Ukrainian children demonstrate resilience while facing catastrophic injuries and forcible deportations during the ongoing war, their stories told through verité footage and animation by Ukrainian artists.

releases.title: Kaali Kheti
releases.synopsis: A story of inheritance land, legacy, trauma and the cost of trying to bury the past to grow the future.

releases.title: The Slightest Touch
releases.synopsis: As she turns forty - an age doctors once said she would never reach - Emma Fogarty, who lives with the rare and extremely painful condition Epidermolysis Bullosa, takes up an offer from longtime friend Colin Farrell; they agree to run the Dublin Marathon together, with Colin pushing Emma's wheelchair for the final four kilometres. Also follow their lives and the enduring friendship that has sustained them through the years.

releases.title: Pratap
releases.synopsis: A decorated encounter specialist is imprisoned for murder, leading to a journey of self-discovery revealing that his arrest is retribution tied to his past.

releases.title: Primetime Preacher$
releases.synopsis: Chronicles the 1980s golden age of Christian broadcasting, detailing how three of America's most prominent televangelists shifted evangelical Christianity into a massive political force.

releases.title: Sadhak Bamakhyapa
releases.synopsis: Bamakhyapa, an Indian saint living in the 18th century, is a great devotee of Goddess Tara. Though he is against the unconventional orthodox temple practices, he uses his divine powers to help the needy.

releases.title: Rob Lowe: The Outsider
releases.synopsis: Traces Lowe's career from his breakout roles in “The Outsiders” and “St. Elmo’s Fire” to his Emmy-nominated performance on “The West Wing” and how he maintained his Hollywood career.

releases.title: The Buffalo Miracle
releases.synopsis: Follow the unfolding of a catastrophic blizzard that swiftly buried the city of Buffalo in snow and darkness, cutting power, heat, and visibility to residents trapped at home and on roads. A McDonald’s manager breaks protocol to create an impromptu refuge, people instantly mobilize to rescue their neighbors, and a community comes together in the most unexpected Christmas Eve celebration.

releases.title: Shankarabharana
releases.synopsis: Shankarabharana is an upcoming Kannada action thriller story written by Shine Shetty and directed by Sumanth Bhat.

releases.title: One Last Order
releases.synopsis: A cherished drive-thru worker receives the day's proceeds as her going-away gift when the community queues up to bid her farewell on her last day in Gainesville.

releases.title: Cameron
releases.synopsis: Two grieving military parents are stunned when their ostensibly dead son shows up on their doorstep.

releases.title: Beparwah
releases.synopsis: Starring Dev Kharoud

releases.title: La Bola Negra
releases.synopsis: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

releases.title: In Waves
releases.synopsis: In Los Angeles, shy teenager AJ meets Kristen, who lives for surfing; he loves skateboarding and drawing. They fall madly in love, and a happy future seems within reach. But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.

releases.title: Hanuman Ansh
releases.synopsis: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

releases.title: Pride and Prejudice
releases.synopsis: Elizabeth Bennet is an unmarried woman and the second of five daughters of Mr and Mrs Bennet from Hertfordshire, near London. The Bennet home can only be inherited by males in the family, so the pressure is on for the daughters to marry well or risk losing everything. While out in society, Elizabeth interacts with single men like Mr Darcy, an outwardly, misunderstood curmudgeon.

releases.title: The Man with the Bag
releases.synopsis: After Santa’s magic bag is stolen, he turns to his naughty list to find Vance, a thief, to help him get it back. Along with his daughter, Santa, and a group of misfits, Vance will have to pull off the greatest heist of his life to save Christmas.

releases.title: The Grim Lover
releases.synopsis: It follows a young man who is saved from suicide by Death itself, who then begins to claim his life, as the two develop a forbidden relationship between love and fate.

releases.title: Trinity
releases.synopsis: A heroic female naval officer becomes involved with the outwardly charismatic Secretary of Defense, only to discover that he may be at the heart of a dangerous conspiracy.

releases.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
releases.synopsis: A heartfelt romantic family drama about two best friends whose close bond slowly turns into love. But one lie creates misunderstandings and conflicts, putting their relationship and family bonds to the test. The story explores love, sacrifice, understanding and the importance of family.

releases.title: Tangles
releases.synopsis: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.

releases.title: The Hunchback: Soul of Paris
releases.synopsis: As cholera threatens to ravage the city of Paris in 1830, a hunchback hunted for medical experiments is caught between political turmoil and impossible love.

releases.title: Empress of Flames
releases.synopsis: Born of royal blood, a fallen princess weaves through treachery and betrayal, trading her virtue for vengeance in a bid to reclaim her throne.

releases.title: In a Holidaze
releases.synopsis: After making a romantic mistake of epic proportions, an aimless twentysomething finds herself trapped in a holiday time-loop, forced to relive the same Christmas at her family’s cabin until she discovers what truly makes her happy.

releases.title: The Boy Who Stole Billions?
releases.synopsis: At 30, Sam Bankman-Fried ran a $32 billion crypto empire until he was convicted of stealing $8 billion in customer funds, one of the biggest frauds in U.S. history. For the first time, he tells his story from prison.

releases.title: Ben'Imana
releases.synopsis: Rwanda, 2012. The country is emerging from an era of silence after the 1994 Tutsi genocide, and people's courts are being set up with the aim of bringing justice and reconciliation. Veneranda, a survivor, is convinced of the need for these trials. Despite pressures, she organises discussion sessions between victims and the families of the executioners. Therapy for some, an act of betrayal for others, these testimonial sessions revive and reveal the traumas that each of them try to overcome, in their own way. The wounds of Veneranda's past are exposed again when she learns of her daughter's unexpected pregnancy and the identity of the father. Veneranda has to face her own contradictions and the dark parts of her past.

releases.title: Delivery Boy
releases.synopsis: A young food delivery rider, who dreams of becoming a police officer, is forced to steal money to save his critically injured mother. Months later, when he discovers that the same man has been falsely accused of murder, he risks everything to save the life he once unknowingly changed forever.

releases.title: Mysaa
releases.synopsis: Unafraid of war and unwilling to stop until she finds that one answer. She carries no doubts. Only the ache of an answer she's searched her whole life.

releases.title: Gunmaaster G9
releases.synopsis: A man in love takes extreme measures to be with the woman he desires, facing off against a dangerous adversary.

releases.title: Secrets
releases.synopsis: Former sex worker Parni built a peaceful life for her daughter, but her abusive ex resurfaces, threatening to destroy everything she fought to protect.

releases.title: Tyson Fury
releases.synopsis: Discover the man beneath the Fury in this feature length documentary from Lucy Wilcox. With exclusive access to Paris, Tyson and John Fury, this film charts the rise, fall and redemption of the one and only Gypsy King.

releases.title: Mickey's Home Alone
releases.synopsis: Looking forward to spending Christmas at home, Mickey's plans take a turn when Minnie surprises him and the gang with tickets to spend Christmas at a world-famous Ice Palace. In the morning rush to make it out the door, Mickey and Pluto are left behind and home alone. They find themselves protecting their home from two feisty villains, a raccoon and a weasel who are after their Christmas dinner, while Minnie and the gang desperately try to make their way back home.

releases.title: The Child
releases.synopsis: The story of Mariaje and Nicasio, the mother and grandfather of one of the children who died in a gas explosion in a town in the Basque Country in October 1980. On a journey marked by unexpected emotions, Mariaje and Nicasio search for - and find - their own unique way to overcome their loss.

releases.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
releases.synopsis: At just 16, Soraya is already creating stunning drawings and sculptures that are as beautiful as they are dark. This strong-willed Afghan sculptor and illustrator has been trying for five years to escape Iran and join her mother in Austria.

releases.title: Who Is Still Alive
releases.synopsis: A map of Gaza, its towns, camps and neighbourhoods. White paint on a black ground. Within the crudely drawn outlines, nine refugees who escaped the inferno tell their stories.

releases.title: Fraggle Rock: A Holiday Gift
releases.synopsis: It's the holiday season in Fraggle Rock, and Wembley can't wait to spread cheer as the Spirit Captain. But when the festive spirit starts fading, Wembley sets out to discover what truly makes the season special.

releases.title: In Transit
releases.synopsis: When a complacent young bartender living in small-town Maine agrees to model for a existentially floundering painter on an artist's retreat, both women must confront their preconceptions of what makes a good life.

releases.title: 14th
releases.synopsis: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.

releases.title: Drinking and Driving
releases.synopsis: Early twenties Iris and Palmer never left their hometown. They work at the same restaurant, share the same bed, and both have a habit of drinking and driving. They run into Levi, a guy they used to know. They spend time with him and his cousin, Phoenix, in cars, backyards, and other people’s bedrooms. When Levi shares a dream he had with Iris things change between the four of them. The reality of the summer becomes faded, the parties die. The four end in a field of unified confusion.

releases.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Merry Christmas, Mr. Plankton
releases.synopsis: When Plankton takes over the North Pole, SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs, and a group of misfits team up to save Christmas.

releases.title: an open field
releases.synopsis: Teboho Edkins and his father journey to Ethiopia, joining a community in mourning both his brother and victims of a plane crash.

releases.title: Sri Sri
releases.synopsis: He loved a girl with no past and gave her a future... Now destiny returns to take her back, steeped in a forgotten life, buried memories and claims he cannot disprove.

releases.title: UK Holiday
releases.synopsis: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

releases.title: My Crazy Feminist Girlfriend
releases.synopsis: After seven years, his ex returns as an unapologetic feminist, clashing head-on without compromising "love" nor "rights."

releases.title: İlk Göktürk
releases.synopsis: The story follows Bumin, a humble blacksmith, who leads a historic uprising following a betrayal by the Avar King. This rebellion marks the pivotal moment when the Turks emerged on the world stage to establish their first state under the name 'Turk'.

releases.title: Stay in the car
releases.synopsis: Set against the dim glow of streetlights and the hum of passing sirens, Stay in the Car captures one night in the life of a fifteen-year-old girl waiting in her mother's El Camino and the quiet reckoning that unfolds in the stillness. Based on real events, Stay in the Car explores the fragile line between safety and survival, love and neglect. It invites audiences into a world where survival depends on silence, and one young girl must decide whether to remain in her mother's chaos or step into her own uncertain freedom.

releases.title: The JLO Show
releases.synopsis: Tracing her journey from the Bronx to global icon, Jennifer Lopez delivers a production that is as intimate as it is spectacular, backed by a full orchestra, vocal ensemble, and 16 dancers. The show blends her most iconic hits with personal storytelling, featuring the artists and songs that influenced her. The result is a show that feels modern, nostalgic, and timeless.

releases.title: Diler
releases.synopsis: A Maddock Film

releases.title: The Wonderful Wizard Of Ha's
releases.synopsis: When a cosmic warp strikes a commuter tracks, a stylish teenager named Dorthy Ross ( Soroya Clayton-Wright) and her trusty dog poodle Smarty  are transported from the ordinary world straight into Stardust City—a glittering, neon-lit fantasy metropolis. Arriving in style aboard a custom-built, purple clockwork locomotive, she is greeted by the glamorous The Good Witch of the South ( Joh'Vonnie Monroe ), who welcomes her with a show-stopping musical number.  But the party is short-lived. Armed with a pink shirt, a purple poodle skirt, and a magical pair of silver slippers, the young trendsetter must navigate the dangers of the Yellow Brick Road after the Wicked Witch crashes the celebration. Packed with high-fashion aesthetics, explosive blue-diamond wand fireworks, and a soulful, show-stopping soundtrack, The Wonderful Wizard of Ha's is a bold, comedic, and modern reimagining of L. Frank Baum’s classic 1900 tale.

releases.title: Ka Kaa Ki Kii
releases.synopsis: Weary of years of neglect, a band of four complete misfits unwillingly teams up to save their village and loved ones. What ensues is absolute madness, chaos, and a riot of laughter as they defy the odds while discovering compassion, forgiveness, and friendship along the way.

releases.title: A Dot in the Ocean
releases.synopsis: A Dot in the Ocean is a gripping documentary that transports viewers to the breathtaking, vibrant shores of Utila, Honduras - until an astonishing discovery deep within the mangroves changes everything, leaving audiences questioning what lies hidden just out of sight.

releases.title: What Happened On November 1st?
releases.synopsis: A whole college skips the second day of Halloweekend to celebrate Christmas on November 1st. Dressing festive, watching Christmas movies and playing music. However, there's a mystery...why and how are people getting murdered on November 1st?

releases.title: Or Something
releases.synopsis: Two strangers show up at the same Brooklyn apartment to collect cash they’re both owed. Forced to spend the day together on a journey through New York City, the pair reveal intimate details about their lives. One of them happens to be hiding a harrowing secret.

releases.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
releases.synopsis: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

releases.title: De Gaulle: Liberté
releases.synopsis: While World War II is raging, General De Gaulle seeks to convince the world that the battle for France not lost. Reality seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

releases.title: Violent Night 2
releases.synopsis: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

releases.title: Ray Gunn
releases.synopsis: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

releases.title: Behemoth!
releases.synopsis: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

releases.title: Flavia
releases.synopsis: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

releases.title: The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey
releases.synopsis: The series centers on one of the most infamous unsolved murder cases in American history, and the devastating personal and public reckoning that followed the death of JonBenet Ramsey on Christmas night in 1996.

releases.title: The Gallerist
releases.synopsis: A desperate gallerist conspires to sell a dead body at Art Basel Miami.

releases.title: Alice
releases.synopsis: From Paris's Belle Époque to New-York and early Hollywood, follow the remarkable journey of a visionary artist who defied conventions and expectations as a filmmaker, entrepreneur, wife, and mother. Her loves, her battles, and her relentless pursuit of recognition unfold against the birth of modern cinema.

releases.title: The Fox
releases.synopsis: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

releases.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas: The Getaway
releases.synopsis: With the stress of the holidays fast approaching, the Heffley family—to Greg's dismay—makes a last-minute decision to escape to an all-inclusive island resort for some much-needed rest and relaxation. As hilarious hijinks ensue, the Heffleys soon discover that paradise may not be everything it's cracked up to be.

releases.title: Who the Hell Is Hamish?
releases.synopsis: Inspired by an industrious fraudster, and the group of victims who eventually decided they had had enough of him, the charming and cultured Hamish sets his sights on Bec, a recently divorced single mother with three sons and access to a significant family trust. When Bec notices gaps in his story and some odd behaviour, what starts as private unease widens into something far larger: a pattern of deception spanning continents and suspected of leaving more than $70 million in its wake.

releases.title: Bokshi
releases.synopsis: Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.

releases.title: Above the Below
releases.synopsis: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

releases.title: Maatrubhumi:  May War Rest in Peace
releases.synopsis: Based on the events that took place between the Indian and Chinese troops at the Galwan region on June 15, 2020 when 200 Indian soldiers bravely defended their territory against a force of 1200 Chinese Liberation Army soldiers

releases.title: Tender Loving Care
releases.synopsis: Amy, a government child protection worker, moves back with her upbeat best friend Rosie, a social services officer facing daily anger and resentment. Amy's aging parents worry about her happiness while dealing with their own crisis.

releases.title: Quiz from God
releases.synopsis: Having left surgery behind for deeply personal reasons, genius forensic pathologist and former neurosurgeon Haruto Hatsushima has dedicated himself to reading the silent cries of the dead, taking a position at the National Forensic Autopsy Center. Each day, the center receives the bodies of those who have met mysterious deaths, behind which lies a rare disease undetectable by conventional means - a riddle concealed within death itself, a "Quiz from God" that Haruto is determined to solve.

releases.title: Eternal Return
releases.synopsis: Cass has come to a personal point of emotional invulnerability, until she meets Virgil, a cartographer. Along with his partner Malcolm, they attempt to travel back in time to awaken Cass to love again.

releases.title: A Long Winter
releases.synopsis: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

releases.title: The December Breeze
releases.synopsis: This is a love story: the love between friends. Four women from Colombian high society defy norms and discover that to desire is to shape their destiny.

releases.title: Eetha
releases.synopsis: Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a renowned Marathi Tamasha and Lavani performer rises from humble beginnings to become one of Maharashtra's most celebrated folk theatre artists.

releases.title: The Friend's House is Here
releases.synopsis: In Tehran’s underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life—until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance.

releases.title: The Baddest Speechwriter of All
releases.synopsis: Now 93, Martin Luther King Jr.'s lawyer and speechwriter reflects on the personal cost and surprising truths of making history, offering an intimate insider's view of the Civil Rights Movement.

releases.title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
releases.synopsis: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" traces the fallout of humanity besting earthly limitations like death and memory through technology and how it grapples with humanity as a result.

releases.title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
releases.synopsis: A collection of rogues must gather information on a mysterious extra-dimensional threat to the galaxy in the 43rd century, and prepare a defense while fending off the first wave of attacks from horrific beings.

releases.title: Fraggle Rock: A Holiday Gift
releases.synopsis: It's the holiday season in Fraggle Rock, and Wembley can't wait to spread cheer as the Spirit Captain. But when the festive spirit starts fading, Wembley sets out to discover what truly makes the season special.

releases.title: Permafrost
releases.synopsis: Follows Marcus Tell and Ann Wilding, the Swedish police's most unlikely duo, forced to unite when their seemingly vastly different investigations lead to the same dramatic conclusion: an attack during Stockholm's Nobel Week.

releases.title: O Saathi Re
releases.synopsis: Plot details of the project have been kept under wraps, but it will be an emotionally charged narrative centered around an extramarital affair.

releases.title: 14th
releases.synopsis: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.

releases.title: Grifters
releases.synopsis: Follow the "Tropa dos 7" (Group of 7) — a group of young people who discover that digital scams are a quick way to change their lives — and see how they grapple with the consequences of that choice.

releases.title: Alias Rukmini
releases.synopsis: Krishna writes edgy and raunchy books under his wife Rukmini's name as a pseudonym, concealing his identity as the true author behind the provocative novels.

releases.title: Love Is Blind: South Africa
releases.synopsis: Is love blind in Mzansi? Dineo and Solo Langa host this love experiment where South African singles date and connect sight unseen, hoping to find forever.

releases.title: Cousin Isha
releases.synopsis: After being publicly humiliated and heartbroken when his lover marries someone else, Ajit, the son of a small-town sweet shop owner, hits rock bottom-until Isha, his bold and fashionable distant cousin, unexpectedly enters his life, turning his pain into a potential new beginning.

releases.title: Devi Mahathme
releases.synopsis: Devi Mahathme is an Upcoming Kannada Thriller-Drama Directed by Nagaraj Somayaji and Starring Rangayana Raghu.

releases.title: Baba
releases.synopsis: Gourab, a journalist raised in an orphanage, dreams of becoming the perfect father more than a successful reporter. But when a dangerous child trafficking racket terrorizes Kolkata, he is forced to balance his duties as a husband, father, and journalist while risking everything to protect innocent children and uncover the truth.

releases.title: Avengers: Doomsday
releases.synopsis: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

releases.title: Rose
releases.synopsis: In the early 17th century, a soldier arrives at an isolated Protestant village in Germany claiming to be the heir to an abandoned farmstead. Even though he proves to be a good man, the villagers’ suspicions about his identity grow and they force a reckoning.

releases.title: In Waves
releases.synopsis: In Los Angeles, shy teenager AJ meets Kristen, who lives for surfing; he loves skateboarding and drawing. They fall madly in love, and a happy future seems within reach. But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.

releases.title: The Debut
releases.synopsis: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

releases.title: Tantara
releases.synopsis: In years of crackdowns and fear, Korea's show world kept the lights on and the dream alive — fighting for a stage where grit could turn to glory.

releases.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
releases.synopsis: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

releases.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
releases.synopsis: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

releases.title: Ink
releases.synopsis: After buying a struggling British tabloid in 1969, mogul Rupert Murdoch and editor Larry Lamb banded together a group of misfits and visionaries to reshape the image of the news industry as we know it.

releases.title: TED: The Animated Series
releases.synopsis: Picking up twelve years after the conclusion of the last movie, John and his thunder-buddy Ted are neighbors, both with families of their own and dead-end jobs. Follow these two lovable stoners as they enable each other's bad ideas about marriage, parenting and the challenges of adult life.

releases.title: Bad Day
releases.synopsis: On one of the worst and wildest days of her life, single mom Joy fights to keep one little promise to her daughter.

releases.title: Quiztopia
releases.synopsis: In an alternate Japan, a charismatic host runs a deadly quiz where winners get any wish and losers pay dearly. His world unravels when rebels target him.

releases.title: Bunker
releases.synopsis: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

releases.title: Unaccustomed Earth
releases.synopsis: When a health crisis forces a devoted mother and her family to return to the US, she confronts buried desires that upend her Indian American community.

releases.title: Killing Castro
releases.synopsis: In 1960, Fidel Castro comes to America to speak at the UN. He is invited by Malcolm X to stay in Harlem at the famous Hotel Theresa. Unsure of his intentions, the FBI, CIA and the Mafia, all attempt to eliminate him by any means necessary.

releases.title: Clarissa
releases.synopsis: Across a single day in Lagos, Nigeria, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As the perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois class and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

releases.title: Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena
releases.synopsis: Michaela tries her best to be a good person.

releases.title: To Hold a Mountain
releases.synopsis: In the remote highlands of Montenegro, a shepherd mother and daughter proudly defend their ancestral mountain from the threat of becoming a NATO military training ground, stirring memories of the violence that shattered their family.

releases.title: Starlight
releases.synopsis: Spanning multiple generations and continents, Starlight follows the poignant journeys of four main characters as they traverse the bittersweet chapters of their lives, culminating in their ultimate struggles to overcome overwhelming obstacles relating to cancer. Yet, the heart of the film lies beyond the disease itself; it is a narrative of hope celebrating the power and perseverance of the human spirit, embodied and personified by these characters and their ability to triumph spectacularly against all odds.

releases.title: Straight Circle
releases.synopsis: A pair of enemy soldiers stationed on a remote border in a vast featureless desert descend into a state of profound disorientation after forgetting which side of the border is which. As they grapple with their identities, loyalties, and the absurdity of their situation, their isolation slowly gives way to an unfathomable nightmare that will blur the line between friend and foe.

releases.title: Summer School, 2001
releases.synopsis: A teenage boy returns to his family after years apart, scarred from being sent to Vietnam while his younger brother stayed in Czechia. After reunion, he faces a distant father, a mother desperate to mend the past, and a brother uneasy about sharing the spotlight. One chaotic summer pushes them to their limits when the younger brother falls from a roof. Between misunderstandings and clumsy family dynamics, they learn that sometimes, healing begins by letting the cracks show.

releases.title: Give Me Some Sugah
releases.synopsis: A Chicago bakery owner is stunned by a miraculous discovery that challenges her to reclaim lost time, heal old wounds, and find purpose in the unexpected.

releases.title: Mr. Bhaarath
